name: Wheatgrass Shot
subtitle: grassy, green, and over in one swallow

ingredients.note: cut fresh; it toughens within a day of cutting
the only thing that makes it drinkable

steps.text: Rinse the wheatgrass well and shake it dry.
Blend with 80ml cold water until it breaks down completely.
Strain twice through muslin. Wheatgrass fibre is tough and one pass leaves it gritty.
Add the lemon and drink immediately, before it warms.

storage: Drink at once. Wheatgrass juice loses its flavour and colour within about twenty minutes.

provenance.note: Wheatgrass counters are a fixture of Indian juice bars, where the grass is grown in trays on site and cut to order.
